title: Lena and the Ghost
author: Mirabel Winterbourne
blurb: Yara Crane, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
